summary: Frontend-only onboarding regression passed all requested desktop and mobile flows, including local profile persistence, alternate exits, donation controls, dashboard access, Playground challenge icon, and overflow checks.
seed_data_creation: None; profile, curriculum, donation QRIS, and Playground content use browser/local UI state. No APIs were mocked.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Covered empty and returning localStorage states, Beginner/Intermediate/Advanced selection, required-field gating, trimmed profile persistence, onboarding skip, donation close and skip, desktop Playground Challenge Trophy icon, Break state, mobile overflow, mobile drawer navigation/close, and visible test-ID uniqueness.
rca of the issue: No unresolved issue reproduced in this iteration. The Playground experiment remains a LOCAL UI SIMULATION with no hardware or backend integration.
